## tasks list

List tasks with optional filtering

Aliases: `ls`

```sh
woco tasks list [flags]
```

Read-only.

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--status` |  | string |  | Filter by status. Values: `backlog`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `in_review`, `done`, `cancelled`. |
| `--priority` |  | string |  | Filter by priority. Values: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `wishlist`. |
| `--difficulty` |  | string |  | Filter by difficulty. Values: `trivial`, `easy`, `medium`, `hard`, `very_hard`. |
| `--ready` |  | boolean | `false` | Show only ready tasks (backlog + deps met) |
| `--include-archive` |  | boolean | `false` | Include archived tasks |

## tasks add

Add a new task

Aliases: `a`

```sh
woco tasks add <id> <title> [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | yes | Task ID (kebab-case) |
| `title` | yes | Task title |

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--description` | `--desc` | string |  | Task description |
| `--priority` |  | string | `"medium"` | Priority level. Values: `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `wishlist`. |
| `--difficulty` |  | string | `"medium"` | Difficulty level. Values: `trivial`, `easy`, `medium`, `hard`, `very_hard`. |
| `--effort` |  | string | `"PT1H"` | Effort estimate (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT2H) |
| `--depends-on` |  | string |  | Comma-separated dependency IDs |
| `--quest` |  | string |  | Quest ID this task belongs to |
| `--constraints` |  | string |  | Semicolon-separated constraints the agent must follow |
| `--forbidden` |  | string |  | Semicolon-separated things the agent must not do |
| `--references` |  | string |  | Semicolon-separated reference file paths |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would be added without writing |

## tasks graph

Visualize the task dependency graph as a terminal diagram

Builds a Mermaid flowchart from the tasks dependency graph and renders it as a Unicode box diagram. Shows dependency edges, status badges, orphan detection, dangling dependency warnings, and cycle detection.

Aliases: `g`

```sh
woco tasks graph [flags]
```

Read-only.

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--status` |  | string |  | Filter graph to tasks with this status. Values: `backlog`, `planned`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `in_review`, `done`, `cancelled`. |
| `--ascii` |  | boolean | `false` | Use ASCII-only rendering (no Unicode box chars) |
| `--mermaid` |  | boolean | `false` | Emit raw Mermaid source instead of rendered graph |
| `--subtasks` |  | boolean | `false` | Include subtask-level nodes in the graph |

### Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
